专题管理: 专题是片单。先建「贺岁档」「冷门佳片」这类栏目，再点绑片挂影片，需要资讯时点绑文。
Topic lists: A topic is a list. Create something like “New Year” or “hidden gems”, then bind videos; bind articles when you need news.

专题管理: 播放器是线路用的内核。直链用 ArtPlayer / DPlayer / Video.js；加密采集地址填解析接口。标识要和线路上的播放器字段一致。
Topic lists: A player is the engine a line uses. Direct URLs use ArtPlayer / DPlayer / Video.js; encrypted collect URLs need a parse API. The code must match the player field on the line.

专题管理: 友链出现在页脚。默认主题只显示文字；有 Logo 时自定义主题可改成图链。隐藏后前台不再输出。
Topic lists: Friend links appear in the footer. The default theme shows text; a custom theme can use a logo as an image link. Hidden rows are not output.

专题管理: 前台发来的评论在这里审。打开站点设置里的「评论审核」后，新评论会先进入待审。
Topic lists: Review comments posted on the site. If “comment review” is on in site settings, new comments start pending.

专题管理: 会员在详情页报的无法播放。处理完打标；删掉只去记录，不改播放地址。
Topic lists: Members report unplayable titles on the detail page. Mark them handled; deleting only removes the row, not the play URL.

专题管理: 会员登录的是网站，不是后台。积分用来点播，分组决定试看和门槛。
Topic lists: Members sign in to the site, not admin. Points pay for plays; groups set trial seconds and thresholds.

专题管理: 批量生成后发给会员，他们在会员中心兑换加积分。每张只能用一次。已兑的不能改、不能删。
Topic lists: Batch-generate codes and give them to members to redeem for points in the member center. Each card works once. Redeemed cards cannot be edited or deleted.

专题管理: 下载页把剧集地址套进模板。不是后台去下文件，也不是播放器。
Topic lists: The download page wraps episode URLs in a template. This does not download files in admin, and it is not a player.

专题管理: 相对播放地址会拼上此前缀。已经是 http(s) 的地址不会改。不是下载器，也不是播放内核。
Topic lists: Relative play URLs get this prefix. URLs that already start with http(s) are left as-is. Not a downloader, and not a play engine.

专题管理: 播放页点报错记下的坏链。标已处理不会改地址；下线线路才会关掉这条线。
Topic lists: Bad links logged when someone taps report on the play page. Marking handled does not change the URL; offlining the line is what turns it off.

专题管理: 采集时扫标题、简介、演员。命中后可跳过、先下架，或把词抠掉再入库。
Topic lists: Collect scans title, blurb, and actors. On a hit you can skip, ingest offline, or strip the words then ingest.

专题管理: 到点自动采。服务器要跑 Laravel 调度，也可以在列表里立刻检查一遍。
Topic lists: Run collects on a schedule. The server must run Laravel’s scheduler; you can also check a row immediately from the list.

专题管理: 广告按位置出现。页头在导航旁，页脚在版权上，播放页在播放器下。过期或停用后前台不再输出。
Topic lists: Ads appear by slot: header next to nav, footer above copyright, play page under the player. Expired or disabled ads are not output.

专题管理: 访客在留言板写的。后台回复会出现在那条下面；待审的不会出现在前台。
Topic lists: Notes visitors write on the guestbook. Admin replies show under that row; pending notes stay off the front.

专题管理: 会员组是点播档位。积分门槛、试看秒数、每天免费条数在这里。停用后这组权限关掉，人还在名单里。删掉后会员变成未分组。
Topic lists: A group is a play tier: point threshold, trial seconds, and daily free titles. Disable to drop those rights; members stay listed. Delete and they become ungrouped.

专题管理: 订单是充值入账。确认已付会给会员加积分，每笔只加一次。关掉或删除不会扣回去。
Topic lists: Orders credit a top-up. Confirming paid adds points once. Closing or deleting does not take points back.

专题管理: 积分兑现金申请，待审后打款或拒绝
Topic lists: Requests to cash out points; pay or reject after review

专题管理: 发给指定会员，会员在站内信里看
Topic lists: Send to a member; they read it in site mail

专题管理: 每次采集当天、本周、全部都会记一行。失败看说明；删记录不影响片库。
Topic lists: Each collect of today, this week, or all writes a row. Failures show in the note; deleting logs does not change the library.

专题管理: 点播、充值、卡密、后台调积分都会记在这里。删记录不会改会员积分。
Topic lists: Plays, top-ups, cards, and admin point edits are logged here. Deleting a row does not change member points.

专题管理: 片子里的角色名，挂到影片和演员。不是后台管理员。启用的才会出现在详情页。
Topic lists: Character names on a title, linked to the video and actor. Not admin roles. Only enabled rows show on the detail page.

专题管理: 顶栏「导航」里的站外目录，可按分类分组。页脚交换链接请去友情链接，不是同一张表。
Topic lists: Off-site directory under top-bar “Nav”, optionally grouped by category. Footer swaps belong in friend links — a different table.

专题管理: 站内资讯，有自己的栏目，不是影片。按 LaraCMS 内容列表来写稿、发布。
Topic lists: Site articles with their own columns, not videos. Write and publish like a LaraCMS content list.

专题管理: 收藏别人给的苹果接口。点接入后才会出现在采集源里。
Topic lists: Saved Apple-CMS APIs from others. They appear under collect sources only after you connect one.

专题管理: 按集写剧情简介，挂到一部片子。详情页会列出；不是整部片子的剧情简介。
Topic lists: Per-episode plot text on a title. The detail page lists them; this is not the whole-title synopsis.

专题管理: 搜到这个词时，按那个词去查。采集入库时片名也会换。不会改已经在库里的片子。
Topic lists: Searching this word looks up that word. Collect also rewrites titles on ingest. Rows already in the library are not renamed.

专题管理: 注册用的码，可批量生成；站点设置可强制填写
Topic lists: Signup codes; you can batch-generate them. Site settings can require one.

专题管理: 分类页「类型」筛选词，如喜剧、动作。不是电影/电视剧那种栏目树，栏目请去分类；聚合词请去标签。
Topic lists: “Type” filters on a category page, e.g. comedy or action. Not the movie/series tree — that is Categories. Cloud words are Tags.

专题管理: 会员在影片页点的收藏。后台只查看和删除，不能代收藏。
Topic lists: Favorites members tap on a video page. Admin can view and delete, not favorite for them.

专题管理: 前台页面 GET。不是封 IP。静态和插件资源不记。爬虫是同一张表的切片。
Topic lists: Front GET pages. This is not an IP ban. Static and plugin assets are skipped. Bots are a slice of the same table.

专题管理: 访问风控同一张表，只看爬虫。图表在蜘蛛统计。不是封 IP。
Topic lists: Same table as access risk, bots only. Charts are under spider stats. Not an IP ban.

专题管理: 前台搜片会自动记在这里。次数高的就是访客在找什么。
Topic lists: Site searches are logged here. High counts show what visitors look for.

专题管理: 幻灯是首页轮播、播放页贴片。先选位置，再上传横图和跳转链接。主题用位置调用，例如 @@vodSlide(['slot' => 'home'])。
Topic lists: Slides are the home carousel and play-page strips. Pick a slot, then upload a wide image and link. Themes call a slot, e.g. @@vodSlide(['slot' => 'home']).

专题管理: 全站或指定会员的公告，和站内信不同
Topic lists: Notices to everyone or one member; not the same as site mail

专题管理: 采集开了先入临时表时，新片停在这里。确认后再转入片库。
Topic lists: When collect writes a temp table first, new titles wait here. Confirm to move them into the library.

专题管理: 会员完成任务的进度和入账。由前台产生。
Topic lists: Progress and credits when members finish tasks. Created on the front.

专题管理: 每日签到和连续奖励。由会员在前台点。
Topic lists: Daily sign-in and streak rewards. Members tap this on the front.

专题管理: 达到连续天数当场入账。
Topic lists: Credit immediately when the streak hits the day count.

专题管理: 一部片子一行。播放地址不在这张，在播放线路和剧集。
Topic lists: One row per title. Play URLs are on play lines and episodes, not this table.

专题管理: 影片、文章、网址导航的栏目树。不是后台字典选项。
Topic lists: Category tree for videos, articles, and the site directory. Not admin dictionary options.

专题管理: 点击、顶踩、评分。每天凌晨会清今日人气。
Topic lists: Clicks, up/down votes, and scores. Daily hits reset at midnight.

专题管理: 一部片子可以有多条线路。每条线路下面才是集。
Topic lists: A title can have several lines. Episodes sit under each line.

专题管理: 某一条线路下的第几集和播放地址。
Topic lists: Episode number and play URL under one line.

专题管理: 前台用哪种内核播。解析接口填在 parse。
Topic lists: Which front-end engine plays. Put the parse API in parse.

专题管理: 给片子打的词，和分类不是一回事。
Topic lists: Words tagged on a title; not the same as categories.

专题管理: 哪部片子打了哪个标签。
演员资料。哪部戏演过在关联表。
Topic lists: Actor profiles. Appearances are in the relation table.

专题管理: 片子和演员的对应，可区分主演配角。
Topic lists: Maps titles to actors; can mark lead vs supporting.

专题管理: 片子里的角色，不是后台管理员角色。
Topic lists: Characters in a title, not admin roles.

专题管理: 一组片子或文章的合集页。
Topic lists: A collection page of titles or articles.
Which titles are in a topic.
Which articles are in a topic.

专题管理: 资讯文章，不是影片简介。摘要、来源、署名、标签、推荐属性、SEO、定时发布都在这张表。删进回收站看 deleted_at。
Topic lists: News articles, not a video blurb. Summary, source, byline, tags, recommend flags, SEO, and scheduled publish live here. Recycle bin uses deleted_at.

专题管理: 文章聚合词，和影片标签、栏目不是一回事。
Topic lists: Article cloud words; not video tags or columns.

专题管理: 哪篇文章打了哪个标签。
某一集的剧情文字，挂在影片上。
Topic lists: Plot text for one episode, attached to the title.

专题管理: 分类页「类型」筛选词。栏目树在「分类」，聚合词在「标签」。
Topic lists: “Type” filters on a category page. The tree is Categories; cloud words are Tags.

专题管理: 搜索和采集时把原词换成当成的词。不会改库里已有片名。
Topic lists: Search and collect rewrite the original word to this one. Existing library titles are not renamed.

专题管理: 下载页把剧集地址套进模板。不是后台去下文件，也不是播放器。
Topic lists: The download page wraps episode URLs in a template. Admin does not download files, and this is not a player.

专题管理: 相对播放地址会拼上此前缀。http(s) 或 // 开头不改。不是下载器，也不是真的去管机器。
Topic lists: Relative play URLs get this prefix. http(s) or // is left as-is. Not a downloader, and not a real server manager.

专题管理: 资源站接口。日常采集走这里。
Topic lists: Resource-site APIs. Day-to-day collect uses this.

专题管理: 到点去跑哪个采集源。要服务器先装计划任务。
Topic lists: Which collect source to run at the scheduled time. The server must have a scheduler.

专题管理: 某次采集新建、更新、跳过了多少。
Topic lists: How many rows a collect created, updated, or skipped.

专题管理: 采回来还没转正的片子，确认后再入库。
Topic lists: Titles fetched but not yet promoted; confirm to ingest.

专题管理: 标题里碰到这些词就跳过或待审。
Topic lists: Skip or hold for review when the title hits these words.

专题管理: 网页 / RSS / JSON 采进影片、文章或漫画。日常接资源站请用采集源。
Topic lists: HTML / RSS / JSON into videos, articles, or manga. Use collect sources for resource sites.

专题管理: 某次网站采集拉了多少、新建了多少。
Topic lists: How many a site collect fetched and created.

专题管理: 对外资源接口登记，不是支付。
前台注册用户。后台管理员在 sys_user。
Topic lists: Front-end registered users. Admins are in sys_user.

专题管理: 按积分门槛分组，可限制试看。
Topic lists: Grouped by a points threshold; can limit trial plays.
Which line and episode they reached.

专题管理: 积分订单。不是微信支付宝收款。
会员申请把积分兑出去，要人工处理。
Topic lists: Members ask to cash out points; handle them by hand.

专题管理: 会员之间或站发给会员的私信。
Topic lists: Private mail between members or from the site.
Each points credit or debit is a row.
Invite codes and who used them.
Members following actors and other targets.

专题管理: 会员发的动态，可以带一部片子。
Topic lists: Member posts, optionally attached to a title.

专题管理: 谁把哪部片子分享出去了。
每日签到、观看、评论、复制链接。绑定邮箱默认关。
Topic lists: Daily sign-in, watch, comment, copy link. Bind-email is off by default.

专题管理: 谁完成了哪条任务、积分解没解。
Topic lists: Who finished which task and whether points posted.

专题管理: 连续天数达标当场加积分。
Topic lists: Credit immediately when the streak hits the day count.

专题管理: 谁拿到了哪档连续签到奖励。
一卡换积分，用过就作废。
Topic lists: One card for points; spent cards are void.

专题管理: 旧的积分兑换码。新优惠券在会员栏优惠券里发，用于现金充值满减。
Topic lists: Old points redeem codes. New coupons are issued under Members and discount cash top-ups.

专题管理: 影片和文章评论，用 mid 分开：1 影片 2 文章。
Topic lists: Video and article comments, split by mid: 1 video 2 article.

专题管理: 用户反馈片子不能播或有问题。
Topic lists: Users reporting a title that will not play or has a problem.

专题管理: 前台播不了时记下的地址。
Topic lists: URLs logged when the front cannot play.

专题管理: 发给某个会员的站内通知。
投放位上的广告代码或内容。
Topic lists: Ad code or content on a slot.
Carousel images on home and similar slots.

专题管理: 页脚交换链接，不是网址导航。
Topic lists: Footer swap links, not the site directory.

专题管理: 顶栏「导航」目录，可挂分类。不是页脚友链。
Topic lists: Top-bar “Nav” directory; can attach categories. Not footer friend links.

专题管理: 同一套片库，按域名换站名和模板。
Topic lists: Same library; swap site name and theme by host.

专题管理: 站点设置存成 k/v，不是影片字段。
Topic lists: Site settings stored as k/v, not video fields.
Words people searched and how often.
Play and similar member action rows.

专题管理: 每天的 PV / UV 汇总。
某天某部片子或某分类的浏览量。
Topic lists: Views of a title or category on a day.

专题管理: 前台 GET 流水。爬虫会标出来，完整图表在统计。
Topic lists: Front GET rows. Bots are flagged; full charts are under Stats.

专题管理: 带蜘蛛识别的访问明细，图表用这张。
Topic lists: Visit details with spider detection; charts use this.

专题管理: 独立漫画库，不是影片分类。关掉插件后台入口会消失，表还在。
Topic lists: A separate manga library, not a video category. Turning the plugin off hides admin; tables stay.

专题管理: 一话对应一组图片地址。
Topic lists: One chapter is a set of image URLs.

专题管理: 漫画自己的分类，不是影片分类。
Topic lists: Manga’s own categories, not video categories.

专题管理: 漫画聚合词，不是影片标签。
Topic lists: Manga cloud words, not video tags.
One row per image in a chapter.

专题管理: 漫画详情页评论，不是影片评论。
Topic lists: Comments on the manga detail page, not video comments.

专题管理: 会员收藏的漫画，不是影片收藏。

Topic lists: A separate novel library, not videos.
One row of body text per chapter.
Comments on the novel detail page.

专题管理: 独立图集，不是影片分类。
Topic lists: A separate gallery, not a video category.
One row per image in a gallery.
Comments on the gallery detail page.

专题管理: 商城插件。积分兑换，不接微信支付宝。
Topic lists: Mall plugin. Redeem with points; no WeChat/Alipay.

专题管理: 谁用积分换了哪个商品。属于商城插件。
Topic lists: Who redeemed which goods. Mall plugin.

专题管理: 友链插件。普通按排序，强化按来路；申请先待审。关掉插件后台入口会消失，表还在。
Topic lists: Friend-link plugin. Normal sorts by order; strong uses referrers; applications start pending. Turning the plugin off hides admin; tables stay.

专题管理: 友情链接插件的分类，不是影片分类。
Topic lists: Categories for the friend-link plugin, not video categories.

专题管理: 点页脚友链跳走时记一笔。由前台产生。
Topic lists: Logged when someone leaves via a footer friend link. Created on the front.

专题管理: 别的站带着本站友链点进来。强化模式用来路激活待审。由前台产生。
Topic lists: Inbound hits from another site that links here. Strong mode uses referrers to activate pending. Created on the front.

专题管理: 普通/强化、最少来路、是否允许申请和自助改。
Topic lists: Normal/strong, minimum referrers, whether apply and self-edit are allowed.

专题管理: 广告插件。文字或图片，顶栏/底栏/播放器/正文。关掉插件后台入口会消失，表还在。
Topic lists: Ad plugin. Text or image; top/bottom/player/body. Turning the plugin off hides admin; tables stay.

专题管理: 点广告跳走时记一笔。由前台产生。
Topic lists: Logged when someone leaves via an ad. Created on the front.

专题管理: 每天每条广告的展示和点击汇总。
Topic lists: Daily impressions and clicks per ad.

专题管理: 发布页插件。首次进首页根路径可拦一层；进入本站写 Cookie，不是服务器 HTML 缓存。默认关闭。
Topic lists: Publish-page plugin. First hit of the home root can show a gate; entering writes a cookie, not server HTML cache. Off by default.

专题管理: 聊天室插件，挂在某部片子播放页。
Topic lists: Chatroom plugin on a title’s play page.

专题管理: 短信插件发出去的验证码，有过期时间。
Topic lists: Codes the SMS plugin sent, with expiry.

专题管理: 弹幕插件。一条弹幕一行，挂在片子或某一集。
Topic lists: Danmaku plugin. One row per comment, on a title or episode.

专题管理: 能进后台的人。前台会员不在这里。
Topic lists: People who can open admin. Front members are not here.

专题管理: 管理员登录成功记一笔。
Topic lists: Logged when an admin signs in successfully.

专题管理: 哪个管理员挂了哪个角色。
后台角色名。影片角色卡不在这里。
Topic lists: Admin role names. Video role cards are not here.
Which permission points a role has.

专题管理: 自己加的定时任务。系统自带的人气日清不写在这。
Topic lists: Tasks you added. Built-in daily hit reset is not stored here.

专题管理: 自己加的任务每次跑一行：成败、耗时、输出。系统自带任务不记在这。
Topic lists: One row per run of a task you added: ok/fail, duration, output. Built-in tasks are not logged here.

专题管理: 每分钟一条指标。采不到的键不写行，不是写成 0。
Topic lists: One metric row per minute. Missing keys omit the row; they are not written as 0.

专题管理: 由分钟表卷上来，给更长的曲线用。
Topic lists: Rolled up from the minute table for longer charts.

专题管理: 心跳、闸门、告警 pending。不是业务数据。
Topic lists: Heartbeat, gates, alert pending. Not business data.

专题管理: 默认停用。触发后只记事件，不外发。
Topic lists: Off by default. Fires only write events; nothing is sent out.

专题管理: 规则触发、恢复、确认。没有推送渠道。
Topic lists: Rule fired, recovered, or acked. No push channel.

专题管理: 下拉框、状态码。影片分类不在这里。
Topic lists: Dropdowns and status codes. Video categories are not here.

专题管理: 程序抛错会记一行，不是谁改了数据。
Topic lists: One row when the app throws; not who edited data.

专题管理: 框架自带。本站后台账号在「管理员」，前台在「会员」。这张多半空着。
Topic lists: Framework table. Admin accounts are “Admins”; front users are “Members”. Usually empty here.
